configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: The default tree, at build/. It sets no MF_NATIVE, so a fresh tree takes the default of ON and dp_bench measures this machine rather than a portable baseline; a tree already configured with it off keeps it off, since a preset that names no value cannot change one. This is the local build, not a CI one: no workflow configures through a preset, and CI turns MF_NATIVE off because a runner is not one machine. Use werror to reproduce a per-push leg.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimised, for a debugger. _GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS is on in every build type, not only this one.

configurePresets.name: werror
configurePresets.description: The flags the per-push Linux gcc leg configures, so a warning that would fail CI fails here first. The compiler is pinned because the two -Wno-error names are gcc spellings and clang rejects them outright, which fails the configure step rather than the build; ci.yml records the same reason. tests/test_stated_counts.py checks these flags against the WERROR the workflows use.

configurePresets.name: ubsan-trap
configurePresets.description: The only sanitizer MinGW can run: it traps through ud2 and needs no runtime library. On a toolchain that ships libubsan, prefer asan-ubsan.

configurePresets.name: asan-ubsan
configurePresets.description: The sanitizers leg. The flags reach the linker as well as the compiler; without that the binaries build and then fail to start.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: RelWithDebInfo, because the only concurrency worth a race detector is the V3 merge pool and it has to be optimised to schedule like the real thing.

configurePresets.name: coverage
configurePresets.description: gcov instrumentation. Run a label, then gcovr or lcov over build-cov.

testPresets.name: pr
testPresets.description: The gate a merge waits on. Budget for the worst case, not the observed one.

testPresets.name: nightly
testPresets.description: Uniformity at scale, the live exact widget, and the heavy solver cross-check.

testPresets.name: fast-werror
testPresets.description: The same suite against the tree CI builds.

testPresets.name: fast-asan-ubsan
testPresets.description: What the sanitizers leg runs under address and undefined.

testPresets.name: fast-ubsan-trap
testPresets.description: The MinGW stand-in for the leg above.

testPresets.name: tsan
testPresets.description: The two tests that exercise the merge pool. Nothing else in the engine is concurrent.
